outcomes.y_evt: fwd30_evt_cnt (future event count in next 30d; regression)

models.I_new_log: Pipeline(median imputer + StandardScaler + LogisticRegression(C=1.0, max_iter=2000, seed=42))

protocol: rolling origin: for cutoff t, models trained ONLY on cutoffs < t; features are as-of at each row's own cutoff
base_rates_note: baseline utility U(Y|C_t) = empirical marginal at cutoff t (logloss of predicting the cutoff rate; MSE of predicting the cutoff mean)

volume_adjustment.method: resid = I - E[I | log1p(evt_cnt_90d)] via pooled OLS over cutoffs 06-09

coverage.05-01: influence NaN (no prior cutoff for rolling-origin training)

leakage_declaration.features: strictly as-of at each row's cutoff
leakage_declaration.labels: fwd30 outcomes (future by construction); used to measure predictive utility, not as model input
leakage_declaration.models: trained only on cutoffs < t (no same-cutoff or future training)

caveats: I_evt_hist is in squared-error units and is scale-dominated by high-activity wallets (mean ~8.7k, std ~92k); prefer I_new_* (logloss, bounded) for reasoning-worthiness work
asof_mm_* network features exist only for 09 (feature_matrix) and are NaN for 05-08; HistGBM trains on available columns per fold
dynamic influence is NOT causal; it is future predictive spillover (plan Sec.8)
I_new_hist max ~0.68 equals the max binary entropy at these base rates, so influence is upper-bounded by base-rate uncertainty
